vocabulary.definition: the action of killing someone suddenly or secretively, typically for political reasons
vocabulary.example: The president's assassination shocked the nation and led to a period of mourning.

vocabulary.definition: favoring or enforcing strict obedience to authority, especially that of the government, at the expense of personal freedom
vocabulary.example: The authoritarian regime censored all forms of dissent and controlled the media tightly.

vocabulary.definition: exerting or tending to exert control or authority
vocabulary.example: The repressive laws limited the citizens' freedom of speech and assembly.

vocabulary.definition: moving from one region to another with the change of seasons or in search of food, work, better living conditions, etc.
vocabulary.example: The birds were migrating south for the winter, following their natural instincts.
